late.because: These are chases you already decided were worth making, on applications an employer has already seen. Nothing else on this list is as close to done.

silent.headline_one: Chase {{count}} application that has gone quiet.
silent.headline_other: Chase {{count}} applications that have gone quiet.
silent.because_one: Replies to you arrive in {{days}} typically, and this one has passed that with nothing back. That is your own figure, not a rule of thumb.
silent.because_other: Replies to you arrive in {{days}} typically, and these have passed that with nothing back. That is your own figure, not a rule of thumb.

stale.because_one: It has had nothing written against it in a fortnight. Every rate on this page is only as good as what has been written down.
stale.because_other: They have had nothing written against them in a fortnight. Every rate on this page is only as good as what has been written down.

background.headline: Let jojo read your CV.
background.because: Nothing about your own background is recorded, so no application can be weighed against what a posting asks for. It is one document and one confirmation.

replies.headline: Rework the opening paragraph before you send the next one.

interviews.headline: Make the fit obvious in the first three lines.
interviews.because: Replies that stall before a call are the biggest gap here — the interest is there and the case is not landing. {{got}} of {{of}} ({{rate}}%), against {{typical}}% for a typical search — a figure jojo chose as a round comparison, not one measured from anybody.

clear.because_other: Every follow-up is on time, nothing has gone quiet, and there are no drafts waiting. {{count}} applications are out.

replies.nothingSent: Nothing has gone out yet, so there is nothing to measure a reply against.

replies.some_other: {{count}} of {{of}} came back. Tailoring the opening paragraph to each posting moves this more than anything else.

interviews.noReply: No reply has arrived yet, so nothing has had the chance to stall before a call.
interviews.none_one: {{count}} reply has arrived and none has become a call. That gap is usually the fit not being obvious in the first paragraph.
interviews.none_other: {{count}} replies have arrived and none has become a call. That gap is usually the fit not being obvious in the first paragraph.

referrals.none: None of these came through an introduction. A referred application is several times likelier to get a reply, so one is worth several cold sends.

referrals.some_other: {{count}} of {{of}} came through an introduction. It is the highest-yield thing on this list, and the one that scales worst — which is why it is worth asking before the next cold send rather than after.

followUps.none: Nothing is late. A chase a week or so after sending is usually the one that lands.
followUps.late_one: {{count}} follow-up is overdue. Clearing those usually pays off faster than applying somewhere new.
followUps.late_other: {{count}} follow-ups are overdue. Clearing those usually pays off faster than applying somewhere new.
